The '''Triumphal Arch''' was a magnificent, architectural masterpiece which, along with another, lesser arch, trisected the [[Palace Plaza/Legends|Palace Plaza]] in the city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the capital city of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==History==
Erected in the city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] sometime after the city's founding circa [[832 BBY/Legends|832 BBY]], the Triumphal Arch was one of two major arches located on the ceremonial [[Palace Plaza/Legends|Palace Plaza]] at the center of the city. Because Palace Plaza was the major thoroughfare to the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]], most visitors to the structure passed under the arch to reach it.<ref name="TPM" />

During the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the planet, Federation [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] escorted [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and her retinue of [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]] when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] liberated them and fled the planet.<ref name="TPM" /> Over a decade later former queen and [[Senator/Legends|senator]] Amidala was killed, supposedly by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]; her state [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]] passed under the arch on its way to the [[Theed Funeral Temple/Legends|Theed Funeral Temple]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref>

Decades later, immediately following the death of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the citizens of Naboo stormed the Royal Palace and [[Rally on Naboo/Legends|liberated]] the city. In the celebration that followed, [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] alike took to the streets, with some even climbing atop the arch to celebrate their freedom.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
